toegepas.voor: Toe draai hy dit op na die hemel.
toegepas.na: Toe rig hy dit op die hemel.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Draai op na' is not idiomatic for pointing an instrument; 'rig op' is the natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'draai op na die hemel' is not the natural way to say an instrument is pointed somewhere
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Rig op die hemel' is the natural Afrikaans for aiming the telescope and keeps the meaning exactly.

toegepas.blok: Wat hy in die hemel gesien het
toegepas.rede_vinder: The nearest noun is 'ons eie maan', so 'dit' could be read as the Moon; naming Venus removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' follows 'ons eie maan' and could be read as pointing to the Moon instead of Venus
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Venus removes the ambiguous reference without adding content, and both the Moon and Venus have these phases, so nothing false is introduced.

toegepas.na: het dit al voor hom voorgestel
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Voor hom voorgestel' can be misread as 'proposed it to him'; 'al' makes the time sense of 'voor' clear without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'voor hom voorgestel' repeats 'voor' awkwardly and can briefly be misread as 'proposed in front of him'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Al voor hom' makes the time sense clear and adds no new fact.

toegepas.blok: Die botsing en wat gebly het
toegepas.voor: Hy is verhoor en hy moes sê
toegepas.na: Hy is verhoor, en hy moes sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hy is verhoor' and 'hy moes sê' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.blok: Die botsing en wat gebly het
toegepas.rede_vinder: The fixed expression is 'in die tronk sit'.
toegepas.fout: 'in 'n tronk gesit' breaks the fixed expression
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In die tronk sit' is the fixed expression for being imprisoned and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat hy in die hemel gesien het
laat_vaar.voor: Venus het ook fases net soos ons eie maan.
laat_vaar.na: Venus het ook fases, net soos ons eie maan.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A comma before the comparison makes the sentence easier to read aloud and separates it from the next sentence's 'net soos'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: No AWS rule requires this comma and the short sentence already reads clearly; a lateral change.

laat_vaar.voor: Hier was dinge wat jy self kon sien draai om iets anders as die Aarde.
laat_vaar.na: Hier was dinge wat jy self om iets anders as die Aarde kon sien draai.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In a subordinate clause the prepositional phrase belongs before the verb cluster; the current order is wooden.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the long prepositional phrase after the verb cluster is normal Afrikaans, and moving it in front makes the clause heavier for a Grade 6 reader.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Buis met glase wat ver dinge
na_skrywer.na: 'n Buis met lense wat ver dinge
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Glase' can be read as drinking glasses; 'lense' is the precise word for the glass parts of a telescope and is known at Grade 6.
na_skrywer.fout: 'glase' in the glossary definition can be read as drinking glasses
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so the writer must decide it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Op 'n keer' is vague and awkward here; 'op 'n bepaalde tyd' says clearly that the shape depends on when you look.
na_skrywer.fout: 'op 'n keer' is vague and awkward in the definition
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but it sits in a glossary definition, which only the writer may reword.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hy het later as Leonardo da Vinci gelewe en is eers ná Leonardo se dood gebore.
vlae.rede: The two halves say the same thing twice; tightening it would mean cutting a clause, which is the writer's call, not a language change.

vlae.teks: Hy het die teleskoop dus nie self uitgevind nie.
vlae.rede: The block calls the instrument 'kykglas' throughout and then switches to 'teleskoop' without linking the two words; a learner may not see they are the same thing. Linking them is a content decision for the writer.
